description: This file contains driver callback implementations and utility functions for Wi-Fi hostapd operations, including frame handling, driver initialization, security configuration, and callback registration for the RDKB platform.

methods.name: ether_sprintf
methods.description: Converts a MAC address from unsigned char array to string format.

methods.name: send_eapol
methods.description: Sends an EAPOL frame to a client, constructing Ethernet header and transmitting via wifi_hostApSendEther.

methods.name: drv_init
methods.description: Initializes driver data structure, sets interface parameters, and prepares for operation.

methods.name: set_privacy
methods.description: Sets privacy mode (encryption) on the driver interface.

methods.name: set_ssid
methods.description: Sets the SSID for the interface.

methods.name: sta_deauth
methods.description: Deauthenticates a station with a specified reason code.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Deauthenticates all stations, effectively flushing connected clients.

methods.name: del_key
methods.description: Deletes a stored key for a station.

methods.name: set_key
methods.description: Sets a security key for a station, supporting various WPA algorithms.

methods.name: set_authmode
methods.description: Configures the authentication mode (open, shared, auto).

methods.name: configure_wpa
methods.description: Configures WPA security parameters including ciphers, key management, and capabilities.

methods.name: set_ieee8021x
methods.description: Enables or disables IEEE 802.1X and WPA on the interface.

methods.name: send_mgmt
methods.description: Sends management frames (e.g., for 802.11r/w) to clients.

methods.name: set_ap
methods.description: Configures AP parameters such as ciphers, WPA version, and IEs.

methods.name: sta_auth
methods.description: Sends an authentication response to a station.

methods.name: set_sta_authorized
methods.description: Authorizes or deauthorizes a station.

methods.name: sta_set_flags
methods.description: Sets flags for a station, such as authorization.

methods.name: sta_assoc
methods.description: Sends an association response to a station.

methods.name: commit
methods.description: Finalizes driver setup, ensuring interface is active.

methods.name: reset_appfilter
methods.description: Resets the application filter for received frames.

methods.name: sta_disassoc
methods.description: Disassociates a station with a reason code.

methods.name: add_tspec
methods.description: Adds traffic specification for a station (IEEE 802.11r).

methods.name: add_sta_node
methods.description: Adds a station node with specified authentication algorithm (IEEE 802.11r).

methods.name: hapd_receive_pkt
methods.description: Registers the interface to receive packets.

methods.name: set_ap_wps_ie
methods.description: Sets WPS IE(s) for beacon, probe response, and association response frames.

methods.name: set_opt_ie
methods.description: Sets generic IE(s) for the interface.

methods.name: sta_get_seqnum
methods.description: Retrieves the sequence number for a station.

methods.name: wps_acl_get
methods.description: Gets WPS ACL details from driver.

methods.name: wps_acl_set
methods.description: Sets WPS ACL details in driver.

methods.name: wifi_hostap_greylist_acl_mac
methods.description: Adds or removes a MAC address from the greylist cache.

methods.name: wifi_hostap_kick_mac
methods.description: Kicks a MAC address from the interface (greylist).

methods.name: update_hostapd_driver
methods.description: Registers all callback functions with hostapd driver operations.
